sentences.en: The company is planning retrenchment to cut costs.
sentences.zh: 公司打算进行裁员以降低成本。

sentences.en: There will be a retrenchment in the marketing budget this year.
sentences.zh: 今年市场营销预算会削减。

sentences.en: The government announced a series of retrenchments to reduce public spending.
sentences.zh: 政府宣布了一系列节省开支的措施。
